newsitem.title: GREECE: Balkan capital mkts should work together -ASE head.
newsitem.headline: Balkan capital mkts should work together -ASE head.

text.p: Balkan capital markets should seek closer cooperation in order to attract investment funds to the region's emerging markets, Athens bourse president Manolis Xanthakis told a business conference on Balkan cooperation.
"The basic aim of cooperation between the Balkan exchanges should be to attract investment capital to the region's emerging markets," he said.
"It is more attractive for international investors to buy into the Balkan market instead of individual national markets," he said.
The creation of Balkan capital market products will boost overall trading volumes and give the region's bourses more international appeal, helping to attract capital to the area.
The Athens stock exchange may provide its know-how and train staff from other exchanges.
"Already, about one third of the Athens bourse's trading volume is done by cross-border investment funds," Xanthakis said.
Balkan companies will be able to raise capital at a lower cost and the region's exchanges will improve their liquidity as foreign investors become more familiar with Balkan companies.
"In today's highly automated world, with telecommunications technology developing rapidly, a market's geographic location is not that important," Xanthakis said.
"What is crucial is the promotion of synthetic products, representative of wider geographic and economic units. Such products are more appealing because investment risk is reduced," he said.
